verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing code, such as SDKs, plugins, or the platform itself, is a fair question for a payments SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions source code availability or an open license for any Mollie component. The platform modules (Magento, WooCommerce, Shopify) and the MCP server are documented only as installable or hosted offerings, with no license or repository evidence.
